description: This file defines models, classes, and enums for power button widgets in the Thingsboard UI, including various button layouts, icon settings, and shape classes for different power button styles with SVG rendering and interaction handling.

classes.name: PowerButtonShape
classes.description: Abstract base class for power button SVG shapes with interaction handling and state management.

classes.name: InnerShadowCircle
classes.description: Class for creating and managing inner shadow effects on SVG circles.

classes.name: DefaultPowerButtonShape
classes.description: Concrete implementation of PowerButtonShape for default style.

classes.name: SimplifiedPowerButtonShape
classes.description: Concrete implementation of PowerButtonShape for simplified style.

classes.name: OutlinedPowerButtonShape
classes.description: Concrete implementation of PowerButtonShape for outlined style.

classes.name: DefaultVolumePowerButtonShape
classes.description: Implementation of PowerButtonShape with volume-specific SVG shape.

classes.name: SimplifiedVolumePowerButtonShape
classes.description: Volume style SVG shape with simplified design.

classes.name: OutlinedVolumePowerButtonShape
classes.description: Outlined style SVG shape with volume-specific design.

classes.name: DefaultIconPowerButtonShape
classes.description: Icon-based power button shape extending default volume style.

classes.name: SimplifiedIconPowerButtonShape
classes.description: Icon-based power button shape with simplified design.

classes.name: OutlinedIconPowerButtonShape
classes.description: Icon-based power button shape with outlined design.

methods.name: createPowerButtonShapeColors
methods.description: Creates color states for power button shapes based on settings.

methods.name: PowerButtonShape.fromSettings
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate specific PowerButtonShape subclasses based on layout setting.

methods.name: PowerButtonShape.createIconElement
methods.description: Creates SVG icon element from icon name, handling SVG and text icons.

methods.name: PowerButtonShape.setValue
methods.description: Updates the button's on/off state and redraws.

methods.name: PowerButtonShape.setDisabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the button and updates appearance.

methods.name: PowerButtonShape.setPressed
methods.description: Sets pressed state for interaction animation.

methods.name: PowerButtonShape.drawOffShape
methods.description: Draws the 'off' visual state of the button.

methods.name: PowerButtonShape.drawOnShape
methods.description: Draws the 'on' visual state of the button.

methods.name: PowerButtonShape.onCenterTimeLine
methods.description: Applies timeline to center icon or label.

methods.name: PowerButtonShape.offCenterColor
methods.description: Sets color for 'off' icon or label.

methods.name: PowerButtonShape.onCenterColor
methods.description: Sets color for 'on' icon or label.

methods.name: PowerButtonShape.buttonAnimation
methods.description: Animates button scale for press effect.

methods.name: InnerShadowCircle.animateRestore
methods.description: Restores inner shadow to original state.
